"[[I've Lost Artoo!]]" is a pretty good card for an Imperial space deck. Since your "[[Executor]]" has only 2 hyperspeed and your "Star Destroyers" have only 3 you may have trouble getting "[[Red 5]]" or other fast starships so you play "[[I've Lost Artoo!]]" All you have to do is get a destiny over one and its hyperspeed is reduced to zero. Now you take two turns to catch up with them and you with two or three "Star Destroyers" completely overpower them. It can also stop "[[Kessel (Dark){{!}}Kessel]] Runs."

A slip: a printed strip showing the card type line and its corrected game text, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 January 2013 (the PDF was made on 16 April 2013).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-D-ivelostartoo-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[I've Lost Artoo!]]: The game text changes: “attempt to knock out” becomes “deploy on”; “starship's astromech or” becomes “starship with a”; “or astromech aboard. Target [Nav Computer] or astromech and” is added; “deploy on starship to reduce hyperspeed to zero.” becomes “astromech lost (lose Effect) or [Nav Computer] is canceled (may add 1 astromech); otherwise, Effect lost.”. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with a title and a white italic “E”.

The same area of the printed card (scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
